item.title: Best Black Friday coffee deals, from simple drip to full café-at-home setups
item.description: From the Cuisinart DBM-8 burr grinder and Keurig K-Express to the Ninja DualBrew Pro, Breville Barista Express and De’Longhi La Specialista Maestro, these Black Friday coffee deals let you save big on top-name brands at every budget.

item.title: Porsche Cayenne Electric makes first public appearance in Dubai
item.description: Porsche’s first electric Cayenne made its public debut as U.S. orders opened and customer interest surged ahead of a planned summer 2026 arrival.

item.title: Score this Citizen Eco-Drive Super Titanium sport watch for less than half price
item.description: The Citizen Men’s Eco-Drive Sport Luxury Armor Watch (AW1660-51H) in Super Titanium with a black dial is now just $297.47 for Black Friday, saving you 52% off the $625 list price on a lightweight, scratch-resistant everyday timepiece.

item.title: G-SHOCK and Bamford London release third collaboration on 5600 model with steel case
item.description: G-SHOCK and Bamford London announce their third collaboration applying Bamford's signature blue to the 5600 model with upgraded steel case. Soho pop-up December 5-8, online release December 9 at £279.

item.title: Rolex authorizes second book chronicling Datejust history through Wallpaper partnership
item.description: Rolex releases an authorized 244-page history of the Oyster Perpetual Datejust written by Nicholas Foulkes and published through Wallpaper. The book follows last year's Submariner volume as the second in a series.

item.title: Zenith releases four Defy Skyline models in full gold cases and bracelets
item.description: Zenith expands the Defy Skyline collection with four models in full gold cases and integrated H-link bracelets. Yellow gold time-only, rose gold skeleton and chronograph versions from CHF 59,900.

item.title: New Balance brings back the 740 with refined materials and “Night Moves” energy
item.description: New Balance and DTLR take on the underrated 740 sneaker with a sleek and luxurious look that stands out against the urban nights.

item.title: This is the best city for an affordable last-minute getaway before 2025 ends
item.description: If you’ve got a few unused vacation days sitting around and an itch to escape before the year wraps up, Dollar Flight Club has good news.

item.title: JetBlue Vacations launches Black Friday deals with up to $1,000 off
item.description: JetBlue Vacations is kicking off Black Friday with some seriously tempting travel deals, making it easier than ever to lock in your 2026 vacation plans.

item.title: Nike brings a woven olive upper to the Izy — first non-suede build yet
item.description: Nike ditches its typical all-suede look for the ACG Izy, and opts for a woven look that's both cozy and luxe.
